method: Artifact-first calibration against every STILL-applicable negative in the current visual-media registry, the bound adult editorial style reference, the final complaint-only companion and the actual full and 390x260 V2 pixels. Each negative was treated as a failure condition before the admission judgment.

results.reason: A generic flat diagram, glossy stock image or copied episode identity would fail. The required result must use the bound adult editorial ink, print texture and electric accent grammar without reusing a person or source composition.
An invented courtroom, named company office, LAiDIES town place, government seal or unrelated setting would falsely locate this allegation-only story.
Floating trays, impossible receipt support, a detached clip, a magnifier with broken geometry or papers that cannot sit in the folder would fail physical coherence.
Any person, hand, face or malformed body would fail the people-free contract and create unnecessary identity and anatomy risk.
Any generated word, letter, number, date, signature, filing stamp, logo, watermark or pseudo-text would breach the NO_VISIBLE_TEXT plan. Deliberate blank rule lines alone are permitted.
Historical courtroom props, dated devices or period styling would make an unsupported era claim. The scene must remain an anonymous contemporary editorial desk.
A verdict, guilt, liability, class certification, refund, damages, court-order or proven-collusion implication would contradict the final filing-only story.
Decorative legal symbols or an abstract four-arrow diagram would fail object purpose. The complaint, magnifier, four receipts and four separate lanes must carry the explanation.
